brief.headline: Push price to ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market floor for higher volume) and tighten payment by 15 days to free ₹2.60 L cash, backed by five qualified alternates.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc for the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap at our volume
priceAsk.basis: Market asking price is ₹0.55–1.20/pc (typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc), with verdict 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec'. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend gives volume leverage to push to the lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we don't know their revenue, profit or cash situation. That means we lean on our own purchase power and on having solid backup options. We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them — a material volume for a private converter — so we have room to ask for better terms. With five qualified alternates (including Manjushree, India's largest rigid-plastic converter, and three listed firms) plus six maker leads to qualify, we can push firmly on price and payment without being stuck.

evidence.point: Market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume
evidence.figure: askBand: ₹0.55–1.20/pc; typical: ₹0.85–0.95/pc; verdict: modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with Bprex
Tightening payment by 15 days frees ₹2.60 L cash for us

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma) — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging firm with broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Bprex's financials aren't public, so we can't see if they're fragile or cash-squeezed — watch for any pushback that suggests trouble, and have a backup ready to qualify fast.

We have no internal price benchmark (no 'best price we pay' for this item from another vendor), so lean hard on the market ask (₹0.65–0.80 at volume) and be ready to show the resin-cost line (87.61 ₹/kg) if they claim the target is impossible.

The six maker leads (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri, Chemco, Srichakra, Dalmia, Ganesha) are not yet qualified — flag each as 'a lead to verify before RFQ' and start qualifying the strongest (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri) now so we have a maker price by next quarter.
Current terms (30 days after receipt) aren't our worst, so Bprex may resist tightening to 15 days — pair the payment ask with the price concession to make the trade attractive.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to work toward ₹0.65–0.80 per cap at our volume and tighten payment to 15 days — the market shows headroom there, and we're lining up a second source to de-risk our supply.
